result.description: A fictional high-capacity portable archive drive built around a compact USB-C and PCIe 4.0 bridge, designed for creative backup kits, field logging, and offsite media transport. The Lunara Vale emphasizes quiet operation, shock resistance, and sustained transfer performance for large photo, video, and project files. It uses a generic NVMe controller design with TLC flash and includes encryption support, thermal throttling protection, and a ruggedized aluminum shell.
result.title: Lunara Vale 2TB PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe Portable Archive SSD
